div.div:
Rules The health is worked out again from the last stored run and the schedule of the use case (expected interval and grace, in the registry). With no run yet, the health stays Unknown (no_run_yet). Unknown never opens an alert. The delivery lane is not part of the quality grade: a missed run never changes the grade.
To settle in S3-02 S3-02 keeps one open alert only, but the engine it reuses keeps one for each health (backend/app/engines/alerts.py): Amber then Red leaves two open. S3-02 lists no_schedule, but the registry requires a schedule (backend/app/registry.py), so no_schedule cannot happen today.

switch.text: Rules The health is worked out again from the last stored run and the schedule of the use case (expected interval and grace, in the registry). With no run yet, the health stays Unknow...
